title: Letters of credit and documentary credits
definition: The documents for a documentary credit, showing the parties, the amount, the documents the credit is to be issued against and the terms of the credit. They are requested where a trade has been financed, and they establish the terms the parties agreed independently of the invoice.
evidence_to_cite: the credit, with the issuing and advising banks and the amount
the documents required and those presented
the discrepancies raised, and their disposition

sources.citation: Trade finance documentation in the assessment of trade-based activity, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
